description: Data of the coupled 118-bus power system and 280-node heating system is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Shuai Yao (Southeast University, Nanjing, China). Data for the Case Study in "Combined energy flow analysis of the temperature-controlled heating network and power grid in the integrated energy systems". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
